---
title: "Design mode"
description: "Use Design mode to select elements in the preview, queue visual changes, preview themes, and send the changes to Copilot as one request."
---

Design mode lets you point at the running app and describe visual changes. Fabricator previews the changes on the page, queues them as numbered items, and sends one structured request to Copilot.

![Design mode with the monthly total selected in the preview. A card asks what should change and offers suggestions, Options and Add, plus quick tweaks for text, color, size, alignment, hiding and moving.](/screenshots/design.webp)

## Start Design mode

1. Open the **Build** view.
2. Wait for the deployed preview to be visible. Design is disabled during local live preview.
3. In the preview toolbar, select **Design**.
4. Click an element in the app.

Design works in the direct app view and in the **Fabric** portal shell view. When the app is embedded in the Fabric shell, Fabricator relays Design commands into the app frame.

## Change one element

When you click an element, a change card opens beside it. The card is labelled with the kind of element, such as **Button**, **Heading**, **Card** or **Chart**.

Use the text box to type what should change, then select **Add**. The suggestions under the box are shortcuts such as **Make it the primary action**, **Make it bigger** or **Switch to a bar chart**, depending on what you selected.

```prompt title="Design note for a selected card"
Make this card feel more important than the others, but keep it consistent with the rest of the page.
```

The card records each selected element as one numbered change. Use **Update** to change the instruction, **Undo** to step back through that change, or **Remove this change** to drop it.

## Use quick tweaks

The tool row shows only the tweaks that make sense for the selected element:

- **Text** edits visible text in the preview.
- **Color** changes **Text color** or **Background** using palettes detected from the app, plus other Tailwind color choices.
- **Size** steps text size and weight using Tailwind-style values such as `text-lg` and `font-semibold`.
- **Spacing** changes padding and, for flex or grid containers, gap.
- **Corners** chooses rounded-corner values such as `rounded-md`, `rounded-xl` or `rounded-full`.
- **Shadow** chooses values such as `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md` or `shadow-xl`.
- **Align** changes text alignment or distributes items in flex layouts.
- **Hide** queues **Remove it** for the selected element. **Show it again** removes that hide tweak.
- **Move** offers **Earlier** and **Later** for moving the element among its siblings.

Most choices preview on hover and apply on click. Fabricator records the intended Tailwind vocabulary and CSS preview, so Copilot can make the source change instead of copying temporary inline styles.

## Change charts

For Graphein charts, the card shows a **Chart** section. You can change:

- **Type**, including bar, line, area, scatter, pie, KPI, table and other supported visual types.
- **Palette**.
- **Legend**.
- **Sort**, when the chart type supports it.
- **Vertical** or **Horizontal** orientation for bar charts.
- **Values** formatting for charts with a `y` encoding.
- **Title**.

Chart changes keep the live data in the preview. The request sent to Copilot includes the chart spec changes but omits the data.

## Ask for Options

Select **Options** to ask a fast Copilot model for a few alternate looks for the selected element. While it runs, the card says it is asking Copilot for a few looks. When options return, the card shows **Options — hover to preview, click to apply**.

Hover an option to preview it. Click one to keep it. Use **More options** to ask again or **Done** to close the options list.

If the options request fails, use **Try again** or describe the change yourself in the text box.

## Apply a change to similar elements

When Fabricator finds matching elements, the card shows an `Also 2 more like this`-style checkbox. Turn it on to apply the same queued change to the selected element and the similar elements Fabricator found.

This is useful for repeated cards, table rows or buttons. Copilot still receives the selected element's details and the scope note, so it can decide whether to change a shared component or repeated call sites.

## Adjust the theme

Select **Theme** in the Design bar to open the theme panel.

![Design mode’s Theme panel with corners, density, font, a light or dark preview, and overall look suggestions.](/screenshots/design-theme.webp)

Depending on what Fabricator detects in the app, the panel can preview:

- **Accent color**.
- **Neutrals**.
- **Corners**.
- **Density**.
- **Font**.
- **Preview in** **Light** or **Dark**, when the app has dark-mode styles.
- **Overall look**, including preset chips such as **Warmer and friendlier** and **Match the Microsoft Fabric look**.

Theme changes are queued as one **Theme** change. **Reset** removes that queued theme change.

## Run a polish review

Select **Polish** in the Design bar to run a quick design review of the current page. Fabricator collects a page outline and a screenshot, then asks a fast model for suggestions.

The **Polish suggestions** panel can show **Preview**, **Add** and an `Add all 3`-style button. **Preview** applies a temporary visual preview. **Add** queues the suggestion as a design change.

## Change preview width

While Design mode is on, use the preview-width buttons:

- **Desktop** fills the pane.
- **Tablet** previews at 820 CSS pixels.
- **Phone** previews at 390 CSS pixels.

Use these widths to check responsive layouts before sending the changes.

## Send changes to Copilot

Queued Design changes appear as chips in the chat composer under a `1 design change · sent with your message`-style status. Click a chip to show it in the preview, remove one with its **Remove this change** button, or select **Clear** to drop the queue.

When you are ready, select **Send** in the composer or the **Send 1**-style button in the Design bar. Fabricator sends:

- Your note, if you typed one.
- A full screenshot of the previewed result, when capture succeeds.
- Crops of up to six changed elements.
- The selected element labels, text, classes, selectors and route.
- Chart spec changes, without chart data.
- Likely source locations from the project files.

Your message appears in chat as a Design card. Expand **Details sent to Copilot** to see the full structured prompt.

If the design turn fails, use **Retry** on the failed chat message. If it completes but you want a fresh attempt, use **Try again** on the latest answer.
